name: task-init-fleet
description: Orchestrator-workers variant of task-init that decomposes a complex brief into N parallel independent sub-tasks, each worker running a full task-init. Use when the brief contains N >= 3 logically independent work streams (e.g., REST->GraphQL migration across api-server + mobile-app + web-app; or implement-X for 4 distinct features that share infra but not delivery). Do not use for one cohesive task (use task-init), for sequential dependencies that cannot run in parallel, or when sub-task scopes are unclear (run decision-interview first).
